entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ACTUAL production complete separated part sources for a layered 2D frog collapse rig, not a preview or finished frame sequence.
Input image is the approved exact character, palette, markings, camera and proportions authority. The creature has a rigid short green frog skull with two prominent amber eyes, spotted green compact torso, enormous pale creamy inflated throat sac, thick frog forearms and powerful folded hind legs with three bulbous toes.
Draw a clean transparent atlas with FOUR ROWS and THREE COLUMNS, twelve generously padded independent cells, read left-right then top-bottom. No lettering, grid, scenery, cast shadow or glow. Full genuine alpha0 exterior. Keep each part at the SAME anatomical world scale as the approved image, with high enough resolution for an approximately440px-wide character. Never auto-enlarge small parts to fill cells.
ROW1: 1 complete green torso/back, NO head/pouch/arms/legs, restored hidden spotted skin beneath all removed attachments, smooth closed curved full contour; 2 complete rigid head OPEN EYES with hidden underside chin/neck socket restored, NO pouch/body/arms, exact skull proportions; 3 same complete head at identical size/shape/camera CLOSED EYES, only eyelids change.
ROW2: 4 entire inflated cream throat-sac layer only, greenish rim and full closed outline, no head or limbs; 5 same sac with air partly released, natural slack folds/wrinkles and softer lower contact contour, same attachment opening and width, not a different character; 6 same fully emptied but substantial wrinkled soft sac resting low, no floor/shadow, exact same attachment opening and cream palette.
ROW3: 7 NEAR forelimb whole shoulder-upperarm-elbow-thick forearm-wrist-three-toed hand, original bent stance orientation, complete hidden shoulder cap and continuous elbow skin, NO torso/pouch pixels; 8 FAR forelimb same whole anatomy in far-side original perspective, complete shoulder cap and same toes, no surrounding body pixels; 9 NEAR hind leg whole hip-large spotted thigh-knee-shin-ankle-webbed three-toed foot, folded normal stance, complete hidden hip cap, no surrounding torso.
ROW4: 10 FAR hind leg whole hip-thigh-knee-shin-ankle-three-toed foot in far-side perspective, complete hidden surfaces, no torso; 11 near forelimb same intrinsic bone lengths and widths but elbow bent substantially farther, wrist and fingers flattened passively against the ground, complete continuous attachment, no floor; 12 far forelimb same intrinsic lengths and widths with matching passive low elbow/wrist pose, no floor.
These are COMPLETE contiguous editable limb surfaces suitable for 2-bone skin meshes, not chopped strips or amputated body fragments. Preserve finger count, spots, highlights, green/cream bands and fine dark original contours. Every cap/hidden side is painted fully under the attachment overlap. No white background, blurry halos, bright red/yellow garbage fringe, effects or extra objects.
